feeds.title: 药物 · 临床试验
feeds.term: (lecanemab OR donanemab OR "anti-amyloid" OR "tau-targeting" OR trontinemab) AND ("clinical trial"[Publication Type] OR phase OR efficacy)

feeds.title: 机制 · 基础研究
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.title: 诊断 · 生物标志物
feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.title: 预防 · 生活方式
feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者使用仑卡奈单抗12个月CDR-SB无显著变化，安全性可控但停药多因经济负担。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非典型阿尔茨海默病表型患者多数不符合抗淀粉样蛋白疗法的临床试验入组标准。

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 机器学习模型可基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征准确分类淀粉样阳性人群的tau状态。

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期促智药试验多数认知改善有限，亟需更精准的患者分层与生物标志物策略。

drug.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Chalcones in Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanistic Insights and SAR Perspectives.
drug.zh: 查尔酮母核经特定取代修饰可多靶点调控AD病理，构效关系明确指导先导优化。

drug.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗对早期AD疗效与安全性差异显著，临床获益有限且不良反应风险高。

drug.title: Streamlining eligibility assessment for Alzheimer's disease-modifying therapies: Prediction of MMSE scores using the digital clock and recall.
drug.zh: 数字时钟与回忆测试结合机器学习可精准预测MMSE评分，有望简化AD改良疗法资格评估流程。

drug.title: Six-month real-world amyloid PET outcomes after lecanemab: Greater amyloid reduction at the MCI stage than in dementia.
drug.zh: 真实世界数据表明，仑卡奈单抗在MCI期比痴呆期更能显著降低淀粉样蛋白。

mech.title: Cognitive and Biomarker Signatures of Late-Onset Temporal Lobe Epilepsy: Toward Non-Alzheimer Neurodegenerative Mechanisms.
mech.zh: 晚发性颞叶癫痫认知与脑脊液标志物谱提示其或为非阿尔茨海默型神经退行机制。

mech.title: Mechanisms, Biomarkers and Therapeutic Implications of Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 神经炎症在阿尔茨海默病中呈阶段依赖性双刃剑作用，并可作为诊疗靶点与生物标志物。

mech.title: Sex specificity of resistance to caTAUstrophe.
mech.zh: 女性对Aβ相关tau扩散的抵抗机制与男性不同，且抵抗相关因素存在性别特异性。

mech.title: Predicting continuous amyloid PET levels with CSF and plasma brain-derived p-tau217.
mech.zh: 脑源性p-tau217可精准预测连续淀粉样蛋白水平，优于常规p-tau217。

mech.title: When less is more and when it isn't: Microglial Spi1 and the limits of what we know.
mech.zh: 小鼠小胶质细胞Spi1缺失经Syk/Lyn/Fcgr1通路损害Aβ清除，加重淀粉样病理。

mech.title: The Associations of cerebral blood flow and white matter hyperintensities with tau and amyloid-beta across the Alzheimer's disease spectrum.
mech.zh: 脑血流与白质高信号纵向关联tau及淀粉样病理，提示血管因素参与AD进展。

mech.title: DNA Sensing Pathways in Innate Immunity: Implications for Alzheimer's Disease Progression and Therapy.
mech.zh: DNA感知通路经Ⅰ型干扰素及炎症小体加剧AD神经病理，或成治疗新靶点。

mech.title: miRNA-mRNA Interaction Network Analysis in Alzheimer's Disease for Biomarker Discovery.
mech.zh: 基于ADNI与GEO数据构建miRNA-mRNA调控网络，锁定AD候选生物标志物。

dx.title: Type 1 diabetes is associated with higher plasma levels of biomarkers of neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation.
dx.zh: 1型糖尿病显著升高神经退行及神经炎症血浆生物标志物水平。

dx.title: Predicting continuous amyloid PET levels with CSF and plasma brain-derived p-tau217.
dx.zh: 脑源性p-tau217较常规指标更精准预测连续淀粉样蛋白水平及阳性分级。

dx.title: An accessible digital single-molecule sensing platform for plasma P-tau217 quantification in Alzheimer's disease screening.
dx.zh: 该数字单分子传感平台可低成本、高精准检测血浆P-tau217，助力阿尔茨海默病大规模筛查。

dx.title: Astrocyte reactivity modifies the effects of locus coeruleus norepinephrine-related dysfunction on tau and its impact on cognition.
dx.zh: 蓝斑去甲肾上腺素功能异常经星形胶质细胞活化加剧tau病理及认知衰退。

dx.title: Temporal order of clinical, imaging, and biomarker changes in frontotemporal lobar degeneration-associated syndromes.
dx.zh: FTLD谱系疾病中血浆GFAP最早偏离正常，先于临床及影像改变。

dx.title: Plasma p-tau217 detects Alzheimer's disease co-pathology in cerebral amyloid angiopathy: Comparison to CSF biomarkers in the ANGMAR cohort.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217可无创精准识别脑淀粉样血管病合并阿尔茨海默病共病。

dx.title: High prevalence of tau pathologies in late-onset psychosis: A PET study.
dx.zh: 迟发性精神病患者tau蛋白病理高发，提示其或为tau蛋白病谱系。

dx.title: Serum Glial Fibrillary Acidic Protein Dynamics, Disease Progression, and Therapy Response in Multiple Sclerosis.
dx.zh: 血清GFAP动态变化可预测多发性硬化独立于复发的疾病进展及治疗应答。

prev.title: Role of sex and ethnicity in the relationships among physical activity, cognition, and AD biomarkers in the HABS-HD cohort.
prev.zh: 性别与族裔显著影响体力活动对认知及AD生物标志物的关联模式。

prev.title: How Life-Course Trajectories of Physical Activity Track With Cognitive Decline.
prev.zh: 生命全程持续保持较高体力活动水平与减缓认知衰退显著相关。

prev.title: Response-optimised training improves learning of a complex motor task and closely related motor tasks.
prev.zh: 优化训练提升老年人复杂运动技能学习，且效益可迁移至相近运动任务。

prev.title: Increasing cardiovascular disease risk predicts faster cognitive decline: A Bayesian analysis of a cohort of adults in rural West Texas.
prev.journal: The journal of prevention of Alzheimer's
prev.zh: 美国心脏协会PREVENT方程评估的心血管病风险越高，农村成人认知衰退越快。

prev.title: Stages of objective memory impairment (SOMI) as a predictor of clinical progression in the A4 study.
prev.journal: The journal of prevention of Alzheimer's
prev.zh: SOMI分期可预测A4研究中淀粉样阳性认知正常者的临床进展风险。

prev.title: Perceived Ageism and Subsequent Health and Well-Being in Older Adults: An Outcome-Wide Longitudinal Analysis From Japan.
prev.journal: Journal of the American Geriatrics Socie
prev.zh: 日本老年人感知年龄歧视与3年后认知功能下降及多种健康结局恶化相关。

prev.title: ALIGN-CARE: An Age-Friendly Surgical Co-Management Model Guided by the 7Ms Framework: Preliminary Data.
prev.journal: Journal of the American Geriatrics Socie
prev.zh: 7Ms框架指导的老年外科共管模式可有效识别并干预围术期老年综合征。

prev.title: A Motor Vehicle Crash as an Early Signal of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias.
prev.journal: Journal of the American Geriatrics Socie
prev.zh: 车祸可成为阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆早期预警信号，且早于诊断出现。

intro.title: Mechanisms, Biomarkers and Therapeutic Implications of Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 大脑发炎是痴呆症的重要推手，这篇综述帮普通人看懂最新研究，知道未来怎么预防和早发现。

intro.title: Further data to address the Alzheimer's coverage with evidence development questions.
intro.zh: 简单说，就是科学家又看了新数据，确认治老年痴呆的药长期用安全有效，能帮病人和家人更放心地做选择。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”时，记性和情绪会变差，帮普通人看懂痴呆症和帕金森病为啥会犯糊涂。

intro.title: A comprehensive review on therapeutics and diagnostic agents targeting acetyl and butyryl cholinesterases for AD.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家正在研究怎么用药物拦住让大脑“生锈”的两种酶，帮阿尔茨海默病患者记性好一点、诊断更早一点。

intro.title: Metabolic therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，老年痴呆可能和大脑“吃不饱饭”有关，了解这点，有助于普通人通过饮食和运动提前预防。

intro.title: Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases: pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic strategies.
intro.zh: 大脑发炎会加速老年痴呆和帕金森病，这篇综述帮你看懂病根在哪，以及未来药该往哪儿使劲。

intro.title: Network Biology of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Neurodegenerative Disorders: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇综述把老年痴呆等脑病看成一张互相牵连的“坏网”，告诉你治病不能只盯一个点，得从整体下手。

intro.title: Worry and Anxiety in the Era of Early Diagnosis and Disease Modifying Treatment for Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇文章讲的是，查出早期老年痴呆后，心里害怕担心很正常，而心理医生能帮病人和家人更好地面对这个过程。
